mentions.name: Restful Atmos Bedside Lamp
mentions.description: A bedside lamp that automatically shifts between dim, low-blue light at night and energizing morning light, replacing a traditional alarm for waking up. After three years of development it is finishing preorder shipments, with a new marketing page featuring scrolling animations built with Blender and three.js and a backend rebuilt from scratch off AWS.
mentions.problem: Waking up to a jarring alarm; instead uses gradual light-based transitions for night and morning.
mentions.audience: General consumers looking for a gentler sleep/wake routine
